description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silo metadata placement filters, focusing on different filtering scenarios and grain behaviors based on silo metadata attributes.

classes.name: SiloMetadataPlacementFilterTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests verifying silo metadata placement filtering logic within an Orleans clustered environment. Includes setup fixture for initializing test clusters with silo metadata.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Represents test setup fixture responsible for initializing an in-process Orleans test cluster with silo metadata configuration.

classes.name: UniqueRequiredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with a placement filter based on unique silo metadata, implementing IUniqueRequiredMatchFilteredGrain.

classes.name: PreferredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with preferred placement filter based on silo metadata, implementing IPreferredMatchFilteredGrain.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMinTwoFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with placement filter requiring at least two matching metadata entries, implementing IPreferredMatchMin2FilteredGrain.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMultipleFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with placement filter allowing multiple metadata entries, implementing IPreferredMatchMultipleFilteredGrain.

classes.name: PreferredMatchNoMetadataFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with no specific metadata filter, effectively matching any silo, implementing IPreferredMatchNoMetadataFilteredGrain.

methods.name: GetHostingSilo
methods.description: Method in grain classes returning the local silo address, used for placement validation.
